events.name: Birds of a Feather
events.description: You, lying back in a chrome office chair that an unseen force drags and tips across an empty wood-panelled office, filmed from straight above as the frame slowly turns and you look up into the lens: the chair scene from Billie Eilish's Birds of a Feather video. Just you.

events.name: Dog Bartender
events.description: Your pet (or you) stands behind a kitchen counter in tiny round glasses and a white bib and makes a 1$ cola, a 5$ cola on ice and a ridiculous 50$ cocktail: carved ice, a shaker, broccoli, a sparkler and a giant bottle.
